newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street gains as bonds rise after auction.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street gains as bonds rise after auction.

text.p: U.S. stocks rose in afternoon trade on Thursday, tracking bonds higher after a $10 billion Treasury auction of 30-year bonds was seen as yielding reasonably solid results.

The Dow Jones Industrial average, which opened higher then drifted down to negative territory, recouped some losses. It was up 14 points at 8273 as the long bond rose 10/32, its yield declining to 6.46 percent.
The Nasdaq composite also edged higher, gaining two points to 1633.
The U.S. Treasury sold 30-year bonds at an average yield of 6.445 percent, in the final leg of its quarterly refunding operation.
